description: When the data last changed (free, 0 credits): for daily and weekly snapshots and each asset class, the newest published date, whether it is preliminary or final (eod), its row count and when it was released; the market level's newest date; recent releases; and the release schedule. Call it to decide whether new data is out before re-pulling summaries, search results or a universe, instead of polling ticker tools.
name: get_status
